text:
Situation: Valproate sodium 100 mg/mL 5 mL vials are in shortage at Corvale East with 3.8 days on hand (13 vials). Corvale General holds 14.9 days (64 vials) and Corvale Lakeside holds 15.2 days (12 vials). The 500 mg/5 mL presentation is adequately stocked at all sites.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the valproate sodium shortage on 2020-12-30 and it remains Current as of 2026-10-21. The Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC plant (FEI 3001833549) received an OAI classification letter dated 2017-12-28, 1098 days before the shortage posting, with prior OAI inspections ending 2011-07-08 and 2013-01-11 and later VAI inspections in 2019 and 2023. Hikma's Portugal plant (FEI 3002807173) had an OAI inspection ending 2014-03-28 and a Warning Letter on 2014-10-21, with the most recent VAI inspection ending 2023-04-21.

Our position: We can mitigate the immediate gap at Corvale East through an internal transfer while maintaining adequate supply at Corvale General. Alternate concentration products from Hikma and Fresenius Kabi are FDA-listed as Current and have prior pharmacist approvals for use with dose recalculation.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 3 vials of valproate sodium 100 mg/mL 5 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Procure valproate sodium 500 mg/5 mL from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. as an alternate concentration — approved by pharmacist (dose recalculation and verification).
3. Procure valproate sodium 100 mg/mL from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as an alternate presentation — approved by pharmacist (dose recalculation and verification).

Not recommended: Purchase from Sagent Pharmaceuticals — product not on FDA shortage list and manufacturing site cannot be verified.
